sentences.text: Daniel Okafor is a solicitor in the employment team
Today's date is Wednesday the twenty-third of September
Aisha Rahman started working for Northgate Logistics Limited on March fifth, twenty eighteen
Aisha Rahman started as a picker and became team leader in June twenty twenty-one
Aisha Rahman had eleven people on her shift as team leader
Aisha Rahman's pay was thirty-one thousand a year with a basic salary of twenty-nine thousand four hundred
Aisha Rahman has type one diabetes
Aisha Rahman manages her diabetes with a sensor and injections
Aisha Rahman's manager until the end of twenty twenty-five was Linda Chu
Aisha Rahman was team leader of the quarter in twenty twenty-three
Aisha Rahman's manager since January twelfth is Gary Whitlock
Gary Whitlock sent an email about fixed break times in February
Aisha emailed HR in March for an occupational health referral
Aisha had a phone appointment with a nurse and received a report dated April 22nd
Aisha lost four and a half hours of pay due to being sent home
Aisha was called to an investigation meeting on July 17th
Aisha was invited to a disciplinary meeting on July 28th
Aisha was told she could be dismissed at the disciplinary meeting
Aisha was accompanied by Tomasz to the disciplinary meeting
Aisha explained her diabetes and OH report during the disciplinary meeting
Aisha was told she should have radioed before leaving the dock
Aisha lost consciousness on July 9th
Aisha was given a Lucozade and first aid by Marcus Bell
Aisha was sent home by Gary on July 9th
Aisha was asked to bring in the OH report for the disciplinary meeting
Aisha was told Gary chaired the disciplinary meeting
Aisha was accompanied by Tomasz to the disciplinary meeting
Aisha explained her diabetes and OH report during the disciplinary meeting
Aisha was told she should have radioed before leaving the dock
The client appealed within five working days as per the letter.
The appeal was heard by Claire Ashdown on the second of September.
The appeal outcome was that the dismissal was upheld on the sixteenth of September.
The client was told they could have been offered something if they had accepted the dismissal quietly.
Aisha was told by Jodie that Gary called her a liability.
Aisha has been applying for jobs since the fourteenth of August.
The client has an interview scheduled for next Tuesday at Harbour Freight, a parcel company, out by the airport, for a team leader position.
Aisha found the report in her personal email
Aisha was allowed short breaks as a reasonable adjustment
The dismissal letter states the employment will terminate with effect from the fourteenth of August.
The dismissal was for 'misconduct, namely repeated failure to follow reasonable management instructions'.
The client received eight weeks' pay in lieu of notice amounting to four thousand five hundred and twenty-three pounds.
Aisha should email the OH report, Marcus's photo of the sensor, and any payslips by Friday the twenty-fifth.
Aisha should check with Castleford Mutual for legal expenses cover by Monday the twenty-eighth and send the policy schedule and wording by next Friday the second.
Aisha should write a timeline in her own words by next Friday the second.
Sophie should draft the subject access request to Northgate by Monday and send it to HR and post to the registered office by Tuesday.
Daniel will send Aisha a letter confirming today's advice and funding options by Tuesday the twenty-ninth.
Daniel asks Aisha if she could ask Marcus and Linda if they would be willing to give a statement.
Aisha and Daniel agree to meet again on Thursday the eighth of October at ten o'clock.
Aisha should not sign anything until Daniel has advised her.
Aisha should say it's subject to an ongoing process if asked why she left.
Aisha should take a coat on Tuesday due to expected rain.
Aisha thanks Daniel and they end the conversation.
